# `srs repo`

```text
Repository inspection commands

Usage: srs repo [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create                Create a new repository at the target path
  copy                  Copy a repository from source to target path using logical portability
  diff                  Diff two repository copies, keyed on stable instance_id / relation_id
  map                   Emit a deterministic repository map
  validate              Validate all repository instances against their canonical JSON schemas
  navigation            Resolve structural repository navigation from the root container
  agent-index           Render an llms.txt-style agent-readable index of the repository
  set-root-container    Point manifest.rootContainerId at an existing container (RFC-052 [R8]). Pointer-only: no container changes, and the previous root stays an ordinary container. An id that names no container is refused (`container-not-found`). Change a root's title, identity or members with `container update`
  unset-root-container  Refused from dataModelRevision 10 (`manifest-root-container-missing`): a manifest must name its root container (RFC-052 [R1]). Point it at another container with `repo set-root-container` instead. Nothing is written
  extensions            Extension management commands
  presentation          Declared-presentation management (manifest.renderedPresentations, RFC-015 [N+31])
  init-new              Re-stamp a seed .srsj with a new repository identity. Modifies the file at --repo in place. Requires the seed to carry meta.upstreamPackage
  upgrade               Normalise instance file paths in-place to the canonical slug-id8 convention. Only valid for file-backed repositories. Idempotent — safe to run multiple times
  migrate-identity      Graduate the Tier-0 identity note to a com.semanticops.core/purpose Tier-2 Record and repoint the root container's identityInstanceId to the new record
  migrations            List all registered migrations and their applicability status for this repository
  apply-migration       Apply a registered migration by id
  doctor                Detect and repair damage from raw file adds and manual edits (srs-rust#857): duplicate instance ids, dangling container/relation references, relation filename/id mismatches, and retired manifest keys. Dry-run by default; pass --fix to apply repairs. Never runs implicitly on any load path
  help                  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

```text
      --format <FORMAT>

          Repository description

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

          SRS version stored in manifest (default: 2.0-draft)

      --package-id <PACKAGE_ID>
          Primary package ID (UUID); auto-generated if omitted

      --package-name <PACKAGE_NAME>
          Primary package name (default: primary)

          Primary package version (default: 1.0.0)
```

## `srs repo presentation`

```text
Declared-presentation management (manifest.renderedPresentations, RFC-015 [N+31])

Usage: srs repo presentation [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list    List declared presentations
  add     Declare a Composition as a rendered presentation. Validates that the composition resolves and that --output-path is not already claimed by another composition's declared presentation. Idempotent when this exact composition is already declared
  remove  Remove a declared presentation by composition id. No-op if not declared
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:

          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
```

## `srs repo doctor`

